title: SQL Injection in Payment API Endpoint
description: A critical SQL injection vulnerability was discovered in the payment processing API, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries.
remediation: Apply parameterized queries to all database interactions. Deploy WAF rules as interim mitigation.

title: Hardcoded Credentials in Cloud Management CLI
description: The cloud management CLI tool contains hardcoded AWS access keys in the source code repository.
remediation: Rotate all exposed credentials immediately. Implement secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager).

title: Path Traversal in Customer Portal File Upload
description: The customer web portal allows arbitrary file read through path traversal in the file upload handler.
remediation: Sanitize file paths. Implement allowlist-based file access controls.

title: XML External Entity (XXE) in API Gateway
description: The API gateway parses untrusted XML input without disabling external entity resolution.
remediation: Disable DTD processing and external entity resolution in XML parser.

title: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in SIEM Collector
description: The SIEM log collector deserializes data from network sources without validation.
remediation: Implement input validation and use safe serialization libraries.

title: Missing MFA on Identity Provider Admin Console
description: The IdP administrative console does not enforce multi-factor authentication for administrative users.
remediation: Enable mandatory MFA for all administrative accounts.

title: Missing Encryption on Database Backups
description: Customer database backups are stored without encryption at rest.
remediation: Enable AES-256 encryption for all backup volumes.

title: Weak TLS Configuration on VPN
description: VPN concentrator accepts TLS 1.0 and 1.1 connections, which are deprecated.

title: Server-Side Request Forgery in Analytics Dashboard
description: The analytics dashboard fetches external URLs without validation, enabling SSRF attacks.
remediation: Implement URL allowlisting and block internal IP ranges.

title: Privilege Escalation via Email Server
description: Regular users can access admin endpoints on the email server due to missing authorization checks.
remediation: Implement role-based access control on all admin endpoints.

title: Unrestricted File Upload in Customer Portal
description: No file type or size restrictions on customer portal upload feature.
remediation: Implement file type validation, size limits, and virus scanning.

title: Insufficient Entropy in Session Tokens
description: Session tokens are generated using a predictable PRNG.
remediation: Use cryptographically secure random number generator for session tokens.

title: Sensitive Information in Log Files
description: Payment processing logs contain PII and card data in plaintext.
remediation: Implement log scrubbing to remove PII. Use structured logging with redaction.

title: Information Disclosure via Error Messages
description: Verbose error messages expose internal stack traces and configuration details.
remediation: Implement generic error responses in production mode.

title: No Salt in Password Hashing
description: Legacy authentication module uses MD5 without salt for password hashing.
remediation: Migrate to bcrypt/Argon2 with per-user salts.
